_meta.data_label: ENGINE OUTPUT — calculated from mixed inputs
inputs_real: inventory status for 16,080 products × 24 stores (385,920 pairs)
network assortment membership (present in at least 18 of 24 stores)
category, brand and net price for each product
inputs_synthetic: category sales velocity and each store's share — from the synthetic layer
[I] 70% substitution rate: this share of blocked demand moves to another product on the shelf
_meta.caveat: Gap value combines public availability with modelled velocity. It does not demonstrate lost demand, causality or a realisable financial opportunity.
